paper_title: Updated constraints on axion-like particles from temporal information in supernova SN1987A gamma-ray data
notes: Paper presents updated constraints on ALP-photon coupling (g_agamma) from SN1987A gamma-ray data using Solar Maximum Mission (SMM) observations. Two main processes constrained: (1) ALP conversion in Galactic magnetic field (light ALPs, m_a ≲ 1 neV), where temporal information improves limits by factor of 1.4; (2) ALP decay (heavy ALPs, keV-GeV range). Data points extracted from Figure 3 (95% CL limits) and Figure 2 (comparison plots). The conversion limits (left panel, Figure 3) span m_a ~ 10^-11 to 10^-8 eV with g_agamma ~ 10^-12 to 10^-10 GeV^-1. The decay limits (right panel, Figure 3) span m_a ~ 10^2 to 10^9 eV with g_agamma ~ 10^-13 to 10^-10 GeV^-1. Extraction confidence is moderate (0.75) because exact numerical values for all data points were read from plots rather than provided in tabular form; however, the coupling type and general magnitude ranges are unambiguous from the paper's title, abstract, and explicit discussion of g_agamma constraints. | selector: text (sole candidate)
